example.question: if I add 200 shares of TSLA tokenized stock to my book right now, how much does that move my overall delta?
lines: Actionable: size TSLA so that its worst observed 24 hours (-8.0%) is a loss you would accept — on a $10,000 position that is about $799; tell me what you hold to see its share of your risk.
TSLA moves 1.29x the Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) while US markets are open and 1.00x while they are shut — the open-session figure is the one that prices it.
If QQQ falls 5%, this position moves about -6.4% through beta alone.
If QQQ falls 10%, this position moves about -12.9% through beta alone.
Realised worst case: the worst 24-bar window in the observed history would have moved this position -7.99% — driven by TSLA -7.99%

Return shape over 720 hourly bars: realised volatility 38% a year, skew +1.93, excess kurtosis 22.9 (fat-tailed — large hourly moves are far more common than a normal curve implies); QQQ explains 24% of its open-session moves (R²), so a QQQ hedge leaves most of its risk in place.

The desk's own last call on TSLA (decision 686, 2026-09-25T17:35Z): no_trade at stated confidence 0.58 — General mandate: the bear case (EU FSD delay, analyst revisions 4:1 down, price below short MAs, elevated short volume) is directionally correct but the move is already -130bps intraday, leaving insufficient residual edge to clear the 16.27bps total hurdle on a short.
Assumed: no size was given, so TSLA is assessed at 20%.
Sources reached: 0 of 1 answered. Did not answer: Bitget candles (unreachable) — everything above is built without it.
Data: Bitget hourly candles frozen on 2026-09-23 (the live fetch did not complete: HistoryError) — the figures are real, but not as of this minute. This is analysis, not advice — you make the call.
